appointment_status_logs_insert_customer.name: appointment_status_logs_insert_customer
appointment_status_logs_insert_customer.withCheck:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM appointments a
  WHERE ((a.id = appointment_status_logs.appointment_id) AND (a.user_id = auth.uid()))))

vendors can insert own product variants.name: vendors can insert own product variants
vendors can insert own product variants.withCheck:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((products p
     JOIN tenants t ON ((t.id = p.tenant_id)))
     JOIN user_roles ur ON ((ur.user_id = auth.uid())))
  WHERE ((p.id = product_variants.product_id) AND (t.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (ur.role = 'vendor'::app_role))))

tenant_users_select_vendor.name: tenant_users_select_vendor
tenant_users_select_vendor.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles ur
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = COALESCE(auth.uid(), (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid)) AND (ur.role = 'vendor'::app_role)))) OR has_permission('user.manage'::app_permission) OR true)

public.product_ratings.definition: SELECT product_id, round(avg(rating), 1) AS average_rating, count(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews GROUP BY product_id
